name: Backrooms: Desolation
desc:
Mark your territory in Backrooms: Desolation! Enter an unknown section of The Complex's never-ending superstructure and contribute to Reymond's research.

U - Toggle Mouse Lock
F - Flashlight
T - Equip Gun
G - View Cameras
Z - Prone
C - Crouch
E - Grab Object
Shift - Sprint
Shift + C - Slide
X - Toggle view (drone and focus)
Q - Actions

This experience requires a high-end device to run smoothly, but offers a low-detail mode for low-end devices.
